newsitem.title: INDIA: ITC pushes Delhi shares slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: ITC pushes Delhi shares slightly lower.

text.p: Delhi shares quoted modestly lower in early trade on Wednesday as ITC Ltd's lower than expected net profit pulled down the market, brokers said.
The Delhi bourse's benchmark index was down 1.74 points at 777.82 after 30 minutes of trade.
ITC on Tuesday said its net profit in 1996/97 (April-March) increased to 3.43 billion rupees from 2.61 billion in 1995/96.

"Reports that the government is likely to announce a hike in petroleum products including diesel also worried the marketmen who preferred to keep their committments at a low ebb," said Pradeep Malhotra of brokers H.P. Sharma and Co.
Newspapers said on Tuesday that the government had tentatively decided to raise the prices of diesel and kerosene to trim a $1.5 billion subsidy bill, but the price of petrol would remain unchanged.
State Bank of India fell 1.30 rupees to 309.75.
Larsen and Toubro shed 1.30 rupees to 215.10.
